name: HTML & CSS Fundamentals
description: Writing semantic HTML and styling pages with CSS, including layout with flexbox and grid.

name: JavaScript Fundamentals
description: Core JavaScript language features, DOM manipulation, async code, and working with browser APIs.

name: Frontend Frameworks
description: Building component-based user interfaces with a framework such as React or Vue, including state and props.

name: Backend & REST APIs
description: Designing and building server-side endpoints, handling requests, authentication, and returning structured data.

name: Git & Version Control
description: Using Git for commits, branching, merging, and collaborating through pull requests.

name: Web Accessibility

name: Testing & Debugging

name: SQL Fundamentals

name: Statistics Fundamentals

name: Machine Learning Basics

name: ETL & Data Warehousing

name: Database Design & Modeling
description: Creating entity-relationship diagrams and normalized schemas for relational databases.

name: Systems Analysis

name: Requirements Gathering

name: Business Process Modeling

name: IT Infrastructure Basics

name: Enterprise Systems (ERP/CRM)

name: Cloud Computing Fundamentals

name: Technical Support & Troubleshooting

name: Network Security Basics

name: Secure Coding Practices

name: Security Risk Assessment

name: Incident Response
description: Detecting, containing, and recovering from security incidents and documenting what happened.

name: Identity & Access Management
description: Managing authentication, authorization, least privilege, and account lifecycles.

name: Cryptography Basics

name: Vulnerability Assessment

name: Stakeholder Management

name: Change Management

name: Product Management Basics
description: Prioritizing a product backlog, writing user stories, and tying features to user needs and business goals.

name: Technical Writing
description: Writing clear documentation, procedures, and reports for technical and nontechnical readers.

name: Presentation Skills
description: Structuring and delivering talks and demos tailored to the audience.

name: Business Writing
description: Writing clear emails, memos, proposals, and status updates that get to the point.

name: UX Design Fundamentals
description: Usability principles, information architecture, user flows, and evaluating interfaces against heuristics.

name: UI & Visual Design
description: Applying typography, color, spacing, and layout to build consistent, accessible interfaces.

name: User Research Methods
description: Planning and running interviews, surveys, and usability tests, and turning findings into recommendations.

name: Prototyping & Wireframing
description: Sketching wireframes and building clickable prototypes in tools like Figma to test ideas early.
